chapter_title.ar: باب مَوْلِدِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام )
chapter_title.en: Chapter 118 – Arrival of Abu Ja’far Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (21/ 6)

chunks.arabic_text: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِمْيَرِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.bn: সাʿদ ইবন ʿআব্দুল্লাহ এবং আল-হিমইয়ারি, একত্রে, ইব্রাহিম ইবন মাহজিয়ার থেকে, তার ভাই আলি ইবন মাহজিয়ার থেকে, আল-হুসাইন ইবন সাঈদ থেকে, মুহাম্মদ ইবন সিনান থেকে, ইবন মুসকান থেকে, আবু বাসির থেকে, আবু আব্দুল্লাহ عليه السلام থেকে বর্ণনা করেছেন, যিনি বলেছেন:
translations.de: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah und al-Himyari gemeinsam, von Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, von seinem Bruder ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, von al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, von Muhammad ibn Sinan, von Ibn Muskan, von Abu Basir, von Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, der sagte:
translations.en: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah and al-Himyari, together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
translations.es: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah y al-Himyari, juntos, de Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, de su hermano ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, de al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, de Ibn Muskan, de Abu Basir, de Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, quien dijo:
translations.fa: سعد بن عبدالله و الحمیری، هر دو با هم، از ابراهیم بن مهزیار، از برادرش علی بن مهزیار، از حسین بن سعید، از محمد بن سنان، از ابن مسکان، از ابو بصیر، از ابو عبدالله علیه السلام روایت کردند که فرمود:
translations.fr: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah et al-Himyari, ensemble, d’Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, de son frère ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, d’al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, d’Ibn Muskan, d’Abu Basir, d’Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, qui a dit :
translations.id: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah dan al-Himyari, bersama-sama, dari Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, dari saudaranya ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, dari al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, dari Muhammad ibn Sinan, dari Ibn Muskan, dari Abu Basir, dari Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Саʿд ибн ʿАбд Аллах и аль-Химьяри вместе, от Ибрахима ибн Махзияра, от его брата ʿАли ибн Махзияра, от аль-Хусайна ибн Саʿида, от Мухаммада ибн Синана, от Ибн Мускана, от Абу Басира, от Абу ʿАбд Аллаха عليه السلام, который сказал:
translations.tr: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah ve el-Himyari birlikte, İbrahim ibn Mahziyar’dan, o kardeşi Ali ibn Mahziyar’dan, o el-Husayn ibn Saʿid’den, o Muhammed ibn Sinan’dan, o İbn Muskan’dan, o Ebu Basir’den, o Ebu Abdullah عليه السلام’dan rivayet etti ki, şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: سعد بن عبد اللہ اور الحمیری، دونوں مل کر، ابراہیم بن مہزیار سے، وہ اپنے بھائی علی بن مہزیار سے، وہ الحسن بن سعید سے، وہ محمد بن سنان سے، وہ ابن مسکان سے، وہ ابو بصیر سے، وہ ابو عبد اللہ علیہ السلام سے روایت کرتے ہیں، جنہوں نے فرمایا:
translations.zh: SaʿdibnʿAbdAllah和al-Himyari共同传自IbrahimibnMahziyar，传自其兄弟ʿAlibnMahziyar，传自al-HusaynibnSaʿid，传自MuhammadibnSinan，传自IbnMuskan，传自AbuBasir，传自AbuʿAbdAllah عليه السلام，他说：

chunks.arabic_text: قُبِضَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَبْعٍ وَخَمْسِينَ سَنَةً فِي عَامِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَمِائَةٍ، عَاشَ بَعْدَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً وَشَهْرَيْنِ.

translations.bn: মুহাম্মদ ইবন ʿআলি আল-বাকিরের ইন্তিকাল হয় যখন তাঁর বয়স ছিল সাতান্ন বছর, একশ চৌদ্দ হিজরিতে। তিনি আলি ইবন আল-হুসাইন عليه السلام-এর পর উনিশ বছর দুই মাস জীবিত ছিলেন।
translations.de: Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir verstarb im Alter von siebenundfünfzig Jahren im Jahr einhundertvierzehn. Er lebte nach ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام noch neunzehn Jahre und zwei Monate.
translations.en: Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir passed away when he was fifty-seven years old, in the year one hundred and fourteen. He lived after ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام for nineteen years and two months.
translations.es: Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir falleció cuando tenía cincuenta y siete años, en el año ciento catorce. Vivió después de ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام durante diecinueve años y dos meses.
translations.fa: محمد بن علی الباقر در حالی که پنجاه و هفت ساله بود، در سال صد و چهارده درگذشت. او پس از علی بن الحسین علیه السلام نوزده سال و دو ماه زندگی کرد.
translations.fr: Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir est décédé à l’âge de cinquante-sept ans, en l’an cent quatorze. Il a vécu après ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام pendant dix-neuf ans et deux mois.
translations.id: Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir wafat ketika beliau berusia lima puluh tujuh tahun, pada tahun seratus empat belas. Beliau hidup setelah ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام selama sembilan belas tahun dan dua bulan.
translations.ru: Мухаммад ибн ʿАли аль-Бакир скончался, когда ему было пятьдесят семь лет, в сто четырнадцатом году. После ʿАли ибн аль-Хусайна عليه السلام он прожил девятнадцать лет и два месяца.
translations.tr: Muhammed ibn ʿAli el-Bakır, elli yedi yaşındayken, yüz on dört yılında vefat etti. ʿAli ibn el-Hüseyin عليه السلام’den sonra on dokuz yıl ve iki ay yaşadı.
translations.ur: محمد بن علی الباقر کا انتقال اس وقت ہوا جب وہ ستاون برس کے تھے، سن ایک سو چودہ میں۔ وہ علی بن الحسین علیہ السلام کے بعد انیس سال اور دو ماہ تک زندہ رہے۔
translations.zh: MuhammadibnʿAlial-Baqir去世时五十七岁，时间是在一百一十四年。他在ʿAlibnal-Husayn عليه السلام之后又活了十九年零两个月。

en.عَامِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and fourteen
en.عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام
en.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death
en.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرُ: Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام

seo_questions.bn: ইমাম মুহাম্মদ আল-বাকির عليه السلام কবে ইন্তিকাল করেন, এবং তাঁর বয়স কত ছিল?
seo_questions.de: Wann verstarb Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام, und wie alt war er?
seo_questions.en: When did Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
seo_questions.es: ¿Cuándo falleció el Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام y cuántos años tenía?
seo_questions.fa: امام محمد الباقر علیه السلام چه زمانی درگذشت و چند ساله بود؟
seo_questions.fr: Quand l’imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام est-il décédé, et quel âge avait-il ?
seo_questions.id: Kapan Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام wafat, dan berapa usianya?
seo_questions.ru: Когда скончался имам Мухаммад аль-Бакир عليه السلام и сколько ему было лет?
seo_questions.tr: İmam Muhammed el-Bakır عليه السلام ne zaman vefat etti ve kaç yaşındaydı?
seo_questions.ur: امام محمد الباقر علیہ السلام کا انتقال کب ہوا، اور ان کی عمر کتنی تھی؟
seo_questions.zh: 伊玛目Muhammadal-Baqir عليه السلام是什么时候去世的，他当时多大年纪？

summaries.bn: এই বর্ণনায় ইমাম মুহাম্মদ ইবন ʿআলি আল-বাকির عليه السلام-এর বয়স ও ইন্তিকালের বছর, এবং ইমাম আলি ইবন আল-হুসাইন عليه السلام-এর পর তাঁর জীবনের সময়কাল লিপিবদ্ধ করা হয়েছে। এটি ইমামের জীবনের কালানুক্রমিক বিবরণ সংরক্ষণকারী একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত জীবনীমূলক বর্ণনা।
summaries.de: Dieser Bericht hält das Alter und das Todesjahr von Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام fest sowie die Dauer seines Lebens nach Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. Es handelt sich um eine kurze biografische Überlieferung, die chronologische Details über das Leben des Imams in der überlieferten Hadith-Tradition bewahrt.
summaries.en: This report records the age and year of the passing of Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام, and the length of his life after Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. It is a brief biographical narration preserving chronological details about the life of the Imam within the transmitted hadith tradition.
summaries.es: Este informe registra la edad y el año del fallecimiento del Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام, así como la duración de su vida después del Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. Es una breve narración biográfica que preserva detalles cronológicos sobre la vida del Imam dentro de la tradición hadiz transmitida.
summaries.fa: این گزارش، سن و سال درگذشت امام محمد بن علی الباقر علیه السلام و نیز مدت زندگی ایشان پس از امام علی بن الحسین علیه السلام را ثبت می‌کند. این، روایتی کوتاه و زندگینامه‌ای است که جزئیات زمانی مربوط به زندگی امام را در سنت حدیثیِ نقل‌شده حفظ می‌کند.
summaries.fr: Ce rapport consigne l’âge et l’année du décès de l’imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام, ainsi que la durée de sa vie après l’imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. C’est une brève narration biographique qui préserve des détails chronologiques sur la vie de l’imam dans la tradition hadith transmise.
summaries.id: Riwayat ini mencatat usia dan tahun wafatnya Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli al-Baqir عليه السلام, serta lamanya beliau hidup setelah Imam ʿAli ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. Ini adalah riwayat biografis singkat yang حفظ detail kronologis tentang kehidupan Imam dalam tradisi hadis yang diriwayatkan.
summaries.ru: Этот рассказ фиксирует возраст и год кончины имама Мухаммада ибн ʿАли аль-Бакира عليه السلام, а также продолжительность его жизни после имама ʿАли ибн аль-Хусайна عليه السلام. Это краткое биографическое предание, сохраняющее хронологические сведения о жизни имама в передаваемой хадисной традиции.
summaries.tr: Bu rivayet, İmam Muhammed ibn ʿAli el-Bakır عليه السلام’ın yaşını ve vefat yılını, ayrıca İmam ʿAli ibn el-Hüseyin عليه السلام’den sonraki yaşam süresini kaydeder. Bu, İmam’ın hayatına dair kronolojik ayrıntıları muhafaza eden kısa bir biyografik rivayettir.
summaries.ur: یہ روایت امام محمد بن علی الباقر علیہ السلام کی عمر اور وفات کے سال کو محفوظ کرتی ہے، نیز امام علی بن الحسین علیہ السلام کے بعد ان کی زندگی کی مدت کو بیان کرتی ہے۔ یہ امام کی حیات کے بارے میں زمانی تفصیلات پر مشتمل ایک مختصر سوانحی روایت ہے جو مروی حدیثی روایت میں محفوظ ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段记载记录了伊玛目MuhammadibnʿAlial-Baqir عليه السلام去世时的年龄和年份，以及他在伊玛目ʿAlibnal-Husayn عليه السلام之后的生存时间。这是一则简短的传记性叙述，在传承的圣训传统中保存了关于伊玛目生平的时间顺序细节。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (21/ 6)
text: قُبِضَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرُ وَ هُوَ ابْنُ سَبْعٍ وَ خَمْسِينَ سَنَةً فِي عَامِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَ مِائَةٍ عَاشَ بَعْدَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً وَ شَهْرَيْنِ .

en.hubeali: Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Al Himeyri, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali Al-Baqir<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty seven years old, during the year one hundred and twenty four. He<sup>asws</sup> lived after Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> for nineteen years and two months’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Asbat from Salih ibn Hamza from his father from abu Bakr al-Hadrami who has said the following. “When abu Ja‘far (a.s.) was taken to al-Sham (Damascus) to the court of hisham ibn ‘Abd al-Malik. When arrived at his door he (Hisham) instructed his people from the Amawids, “When I will finish exasperating Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) and stop then each of you one after the other should reprimand and level blames on him.” He then ordered to allow Muhammad ibn Ali to come to his presence. When abu Ja‘far (a.s.) arrived he made a gesture with his hand to all of them and offered a general greeting. He then sat down. This increased the disappointment of Hisham because he did not he did not address him as the caliph and sat down without his permission. Hisham then began to reprimand and scold him and said to him among other things, “O Muhammad ibn Ali, why is it that one or the other from cause disunity among the Muslims and call people to follow him thinking that he is the Imam because of his ignorance and foolishness. He scolded him as much as he wanted. When he became quite others one after the other began to annoy and nag him. When they all became quite, he rose and stood up and said, “O people, what is that you want and where are you headed? Through us, Allah granted you guidance to the first one of you and through us the last of you can receive guidance. If you have a temporary power to us belongs the future power and there will be no power after our power because to us belong the consequences as Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, has said, “The final victory is for the pious ones.” [7:128].” He ordered to imprison him. In the prison to whoever that he spoke he would sympathize with him. The guard came to Hisham and said, “O Amir al-Mu’minin, I am afraid for from the people al-Sham (Damascus). They may remove you from this position. He gave him the full report. Hisham then ordered to escort the Imam (a.s.) and his people to Madina. He ordered his people not to allow the Imam and his people to go to marketplaces. They were denied food and water. They traveled three days without food and water until they arrived at Madyan. They were left behind the locked doors therein. People of the Imam complained to him for hanger and thirst. The Imam (a.s.) has said the he then climbed a hill above them and said loudly, “O people of Madyan, the town of unjust people. I am Baqiyat Allah (the power that Allah has kept in reserve) as He has said, “If you are true believers then know that the profit (the reserved power) which God has left for you is better for you (than what you may gain through deceitful ways). I am not responsible for your deeds.” [11:86] The Imam (a.s.) has said that among them there was an old man who went to them (people of the town) and said, “By Allah, this is the call of Shu‘ayb the Prophet of Allah. If you would not go to this man in the marketplaces, you will be seized from the above and below. Believe me and obey me this time but you may reject me next time. I am giving you a good advise.” The Imam (a.s.) has said, ‘They came out quickly to Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) and his people in the marketplace. The news reached Hisham ibn ‘Abd al-Malik who summoned the old man and he was taken to the court but it is not known what did he do to him.”
